name: gov-ts-backend-template
description: Government Digital Services - Typescript Backend Template
author: Ant Addis

scripts.db:reset: rm -rf node_modules/.prisma/client/ prisma/migrations/ prisma/cee.db prisma/test.db && npx prisma format && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma generate
scripts.docker:migrate: docker run --rm -e DATABASE_URL="file:/data/cee.db" -v "$(pwd)/data:/data" fst-api npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.docker:seed: docker run --rm -e DATABASE_URL="file:/data/cee.db" -v "$(pwd)/data:/data" fst-api node dist/prisma/seed.js
scripts.docker:build-run: yarn docker:build && yarn docker:migrate && yarn docker:seed && yarn docker:run
scripts.demo:migrate: kamal app exec -d demo "yarn prisma migrate deploy"
scripts.demo:deploy: kamal deploy -d demo && yarn demo:migrate && yarn demo:seed
